name: com.gameframex.unity.advertisement
description:
GameFrameX Advertisement — Unity advertisement package providing the IAdvertisementManager abstraction and AdvertisementComponent for quick ad integration on GameFrameX modular architecture. Ships BaseAdvertisementManager, AdvertisementConfig and AdvertisementPlayOption, plus an AdvertisementRegistry that channel packages self-register into via bootstraps with mutually exclusive resolution and explicit channel-id override, without type-name string reflection. Includes built-in reward callback handling for rewarded ads; adapters exist for CSJ, TopOn and WeChat, Douyin, Kuaishou and Alipay Mini Games. Docs: https://gameframex.doc.alianblank.com

GameFrameX Advertisement — Unity 广告功能包，基于 GameFrameX 模块化架构提供 IAdvertisementManager 抽象与 AdvertisementComponent，可快速集成广告功能。包含 BaseAdvertisementManager、AdvertisementConfig、AdvertisementPlayOption，以及由渠道包 Bootstrap 自注册的 AdvertisementRegistry，支持互斥解析与显式渠道 ID 覆盖，无需类型名字符串反射。内置激励视频广告的奖励回调处理；提供 CSJ、TopOn 及微信、抖音、快手、支付宝小游戏渠道适配包。文档：https://gameframex.doc.alianblank.com
